curation.headline: DeepSeek's DSpark framework boosts AI inference speed up to 85 percent
curation.whyItMatters: DSpark's speculative-decoding approach squeezes 60–85% more per-user throughput from existing chips, potentially letting Chinese labs close the hardware gap imposed by US export controls — a significant capability and geopolitical signal for anyone tracking frontier AI competitiveness.
curation.caveat: Benchmarks come from DeepSeek itself and have not been independently reproduced; real-world gains will vary by workload and hardware configuration.

curation.headline: Deloitte internal deck warns AI agents will kill the billable hour by 2035
curation.whyItMatters: An internal Deloitte presentation projecting that hourly billing will shrink to a 'thin sliver' by 2035 is a rare candid signal from a Big Four firm that AI-driven business model disruption is now being planned for internally, not just discussed externally — directly relevant to how knowledge work is priced and staffed.
curation.caveat: The presentation is internal and unverified; projections to 2035 carry enormous uncertainty and may serve change-management purposes within the firm.

curation.headline: Amazon engineers distill Anthropic models internally to dodge rising token costs
curation.whyItMatters: Amazon reportedly distilling Claude into cheaper internal variants — while also exploring OpenAI as an alternative — signals that even Anthropic's largest cloud partner is hedging against the new token-based pricing model, with broad implications for how enterprises will manage AI vendor lock-in.
curation.caveat: The report relies on unnamed sources and Amazon has not confirmed the distillation effort or its scale.

curation.headline: Meta bans Claude Code and Codex internally to protect its own training data
curation.whyItMatters: Meta's policy reveals a new competitive dynamic: frontier labs must now worry that their AI coding tools could inadvertently enrich rivals' training pipelines, a concern that will likely spread to other large AI developers and reshape enterprise AI tool policies.
curation.caveat: The scope of the restriction and whether it applies to all Meta engineers or specific teams has not been fully detailed.

curation.headline: Tidal demonetizes all 100-percent AI-generated music starting immediately
curation.whyItMatters: Tidal's move is one of the first concrete platform-level monetization policies targeting AI-generated music, setting a precedent that other streaming services may follow and directly affecting creators and AI music tool developers.
curation.caveat: Tidal's automated detection of '100 percent AI-generated' tracks is technically difficult and the accuracy of its detection tools has not been disclosed.

curation.headline: New report finds high-intensity AI adopters grew headcount 10 percent including junior roles
curation.whyItMatters: Counter-evidence to the 'AI kills jobs' narrative — companies most aggressively adopting AI saw entry-level headcount rise 12%, complicating the picture painted by Anthropic's recent 'no junior engineers needed' claim and directly relevant to workforce planning decisions.
curation.caveat: The dataset and methodology behind the report have not been fully disclosed, and correlation between AI adoption intensity and headcount growth may reflect selection bias toward fast-growing companies.
